mapper.select: SELECT PRDC_CD AS productCode, PRDC_NM AS productName, PRDC_ABBR AS productAbbr, PRDC_FLL_NM AS productFullName, DT AS snapshotDate FROM dws_product_info_d WHERE DT = #{partitionDate} AND #{entityReference} <> '' AND (PRDC_CD = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_NM = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_ABBR = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_FLL_NM = #{entityReference} OR LOCATE(#{entityReference}, PRDC_NM) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{entityReference}, PRDC_ABBR) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{entityReference}, PRDC_FLL_NM) > 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRDC_CD = #{entityReference} THEN 0 WHEN PRDC_NM = #{entityReference} THEN 1 WHEN PRDC_ABBR = #{entityReference} THEN 2 WHEN PRDC_FLL_NM = #{entityReference} THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, PRDC_CD ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT PRDC_CD AS productCode, PRDC_NM AS productName, PRDC_ABBR AS productAbbr, PRDC_FLL_NM AS productFullName, PRDC_MNGR_NM AS productManager, INVS_MNGR_NM AS regulatoryInvestmentManager, PRDC_INVS_MNGR AS departmentInvestmentManager, PRDC_FRM AS productForm, PROD_MAT_DT AS endDate, PROD_MAT_DT AS productMaturityDate, PERI_OPEN_BASE_DT AS periodicOpenBaseDate, DT AS snapshotDate FROM dws_product_info_d WHERE DT = #{partitionDate} AND #{entityReference} <> '' AND (PRDC_CD = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_NM = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_ABBR = #{entityReference} OR PRDC_FLL_NM = #{entityReference}) ORDER BY PRDC_CD ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT PRDC_CD AS productCode, PRDC_NM AS productName, PROD_MAT_DT AS productMaturityDate, PERI_OPEN_BASE_DT AS periodicOpenBaseDate, DT AS snapshotDate, CASE WHEN PERI_OPEN_BASE_DT = #{businessDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS periodicOpenBaseDateMatched, CASE WHEN PROD_MAT_DT = #{businessDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS productMaturityDateMatched FROM dws_product_info_d WHERE DT = #{partitionDate} AND (PERI_OPEN_BASE_DT = #{businessDate} OR PROD_MAT_DT = #{businessDate}) ORDER BY PRDC_CD ASC LIMIT #{limit}
